name: Easy Dutch Oven Beef & Mushroom Ravioli Stew with Lemon-Garlic Arugula

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large Dutch oven or pot over medium-high heat.
Meanwhile, pat beef dry with paper towels, then place in a medium bowl along with flour and spices. Toss to coat.
instructions.secondary_message:
680 g beef for stew
2 tbsp all-purpose flour
1 tsp Italian seasoning
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the Dutch oven is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add beef and cook, stirring occasionally, until browned, 3-4 minutes (the beef will not be cooked all the way through). Transfer to a plate. (Reserve Dutch oven with drippings for later use.)
Meanwhile, peel, halve, and slice onion crosswise into thin half-moons.
Return Dutch oven (with drippings) to medium heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion and garlic; cook, stirring occasionally, until onion is softened, 3-4 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp minced garlic

instructions.primary_message: When the onion is soft, return seared beef (and any accumulated juices) to the Dutch oven, along with broth, mushrooms, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine the stew, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom of the pot, then bring to a simmer over high heat. Once simmering, reduce heat to low, cover, and cook until beef is very tender, about 1 ½ hours.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 cups beef broth
1 (227 g) pkg sliced white mushrooms
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the stew is done, uncover and increase heat to medium-high. Add ravioli and cream; continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until ravioli are tender, 4-5 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (283 g) bag mushroom ravioli, fresh or frozen
½ cup heavy whipping cream

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry arugula (skip this step if it came pre-washed). Place in a medium bowl, along with dressing, and toss to coat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (142 g) pkg baby arugula
¼ cup lemon garlic vinaigrette

instructions.primary_message: Divide stew between bowls and serve with arugula on the side. Enjoy!
